subject.title: Dashboard: workspace time-travel — history scrub, version diff, and widget→logbook blame

question: Should OpenClaw accept dashboard workspace time-travel and widget-to-Logbook blame as a bundled dashboard feature after the Wave 1 dashboard stack lands?
rationale: The request is a new user-facing auditability surface over unmerged dashboard state and sensitive Logbook timeline data, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product and privacy boundary.

options.title: Keep as roadmap feature
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical feature item and revisit implementation after the dashboard substrate and security review are settled.

options.title: Fold into roadmap only
options.body: Track the idea only in the broader dashboard roadmap if maintainers do not want a separate implementation issue yet.

options.title: Decline bundled scope
options.body: Close the item if maintainers decide workspace history/blame belongs outside the bundled dashboard experience.

recommendation.title: Keep as roadmap feature
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical feature item and revisit implementation after the dashboard substrate and security review are settled.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the adjacent Logbook surface and is the strongest current-main owner signal for the Control UI plugin-tab path this feature would connect to.
